parameters.help_en: The Integrated Circuit Card Identifiers (ICCIDs) of the Internet of Things (IoT) SIM cards. You can specify up to 500 ICCIDs at a time
parameters.help_zh: 物联网SIM卡卡号，每次最大500条
parameters.name: iccids

parameters.help_en:
A client-generated token that ensures the idempotence of the request. Make sure that the token is unique for each request. The token can contain only ASCII characters and must be no more than 64 characters long.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: Sends a check request without locking the cards. The system checks for required parameters, the request format, and service limits. If the check fails, an error is returned. If the check passes, the system returns the `DryRunOperation` error code.

false (default): Sends a normal request. After the check passes, the system locks the cards
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会批量锁定。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后批量锁定卡
parameters.name: dry_run
